title: Prosecutor: Tata Steel intentionally polluted IJmuiden 598 times
intro: This edition brings together 42 developments covering the global steel industry, collected from 31 publishers for Saturday, 21 November 2026. Stories are ranked by relevance and importance. AI editorial commentary was not available for this edition, so summaries are the publishers' own excerpts.
